# Analysis plan (written before the main runs; revisions are appended at the end, never silently)

Source: `idea-repo` Brief rev. 4 (predictions P1–P5, acceptance rule), `story-repo` Outline rev. 1 (claims C0–C7),
objective `experiment-repo`#1. Everything below is code in this repository (`src/gate`, `scripts/`).

## 1. Harness
* **Estimand**: GATE τ = mean_i Y_i(1) − mean_i Y_i(0), evaluated by running each outcome function at z=1 and z=0
  (`mech.exact_tau`; equals 1 up to 1.3e-4 for mechanism (e), whose K=30-step truncation is part of the DGP).
  Errors are (τ̂ − τ)/τ with τ = 1.
* **Graphs**: SBM (blocks of ≈100 nodes, 30 % of edge mass between blocks), ER, Barabási–Albert (m = d/2),
  Watts–Strogatz (β = 0.1), n = 3000 unless stated; socfb-Stanford3 and SNAP ego-Facebook (sha256 verified against
  `data.md`), giant component only. On real graphs degree is varied by independent edge thinning (target mean degree
  5/20/80; ego-Facebook has 43.7, so "80" means the full graph there); clustering coefficient, maximum degree and n of every
  realised graph are stored (`gmeta`) and reported with every degree effect.
* **Mechanisms** (all calibrated to τ = 1; spillover share s ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}, plus the s = 0 null, one column):
  (a) (1−s)z + s f; (b) (1−s)z + s c/d̄ (count, degree scaled); (c) (1−s)z + s g(f), g saturating with κ = 3;
  (d) (1−s)z + s·1[f ≥ 0.6]; (e) (1−ρ)Σ_{k≤30} ρ^k W^k z with ρ = s; (f) (1−s)z + (s/2)f + (s/2)zf.
  f = treated-neighbour fraction, c = count. Outcome = a_i + this part (+ noise).
* **Baselines a_i** (SD 1): iid (default), degree-correlated (0.8 standardised log-degree + 0.6 iid), community-correlated
  (0.8 block effect + 0.6 iid), none (sanity only).
* **Noise**: ε iid N(0,1) scaled by σ = m·SD(noise-free outcome of that column), m ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 1} (SD from 30 pilot
  assignments per graph draw; tabulated per mechanism × s in `calibration.csv`).
* **Replicate structure**: graph draws (G = 10 synthetic; 1 for fixed real graphs) × assignment draws (R = 300; 3000
  on real graphs) × one noise draw per assignment (common to all columns/estimators). Every Tier-G estimator is a linear

  at any m; the exact conditional noise variance (mσ_j)²·‖w‖² is stored too (‖w‖² = L/n for the regression estimators).
  This gives the variance split Var(τ̂) = E[σ²‖w‖²] (noise) + Var(w'y₀) (assignment/graph) exactly.
* **Designs**: Bernoulli(p), p ∈ {0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9}; graph-cluster randomisation: cluster-level Bernoulli(p=½),

  resolutions, reported, not tuned per graph) or planted SBM blocks (oracle).
* **Edge noise**: outcomes on the true graph, all features/designs/exposure probabilities on a graph with q ∈ {0.1, 0.3}
  of true edges removed (each node keeps ≥ 1 edge).

cd /hutian/wikis/wiki && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='Outline.md'; s=open(p).read()
a=s.index("## 5. Page and figure budget"); b=s.index("## 6. What each neighbour")
new="""## 5. Page and figure budget (confirmed by `venue`, `story-repo`#4: NeurIPS 2026, contribution type General)
Main text 9 pages including all figures and tables (references, appendix and checklist outside); at most 6 figures + 2 tables in the body (~2.4 pages), ~6 pages of text; 35–60 read references; each main-text claim must stand alone, with the appendix unread. Placement:
- **Main text, 6 figures + 2 tables**: Fig 1 (C4 regime map + sign-error panel + real-graph rows), Fig 3 (C2 bias vs SD with degree, with a second row of bias/SD vs p carrying C3), Fig 5 (C4 tiers), Fig 6 (C5 cluster designs), Fig 7 (C6 diagnostic, D vs tie cells, per-group gains), Fig 9 (C8 coverage). Tables 1 (mechanisms, calibration) and 2 (acceptance-rule criteria and verdict).
- **Appendix, with the claim stated in one sentence in the text and a pointer**: Fig 2 (C1 variance vs σ²L/n, n and d exponents; the C1 numbers go into the text), Fig 4 (C3 detail if the panel row in Fig 3 is too small), Fig 8 (C7 edge-noise tiers and real-graph degree thinning), Table 3 (regime table with coverage and sign error), cell list, calibration/SNR tables, per-mechanism bias derivations.
- If a result changes which claims are the paper's story (e.g. C1's departures turn out to be the finding), the figures swap: the page budget is the constraint, not the outline's numbering. If the headline turns out a pure negative result, `venue` is told (type "General" vs "Negative Results").
`presentation` tells me a claim a figure cannot show clearly at this size.

"""
s=s[:a]+new+s[b:]
s=s.replace("(revision 3: review round 1 and Brief revision 5)","(revision 4: review round 1, Brief revision 5, venue budget)")
old="independent of d; at small d the support straddles the threshold."
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,"independent of d in the limit of large d; at small d the support straddles the threshold and the bias is smaller or of opposite sign (`analysis` plan §3: the threshold slope does depend on d; the d-independence holds for smooth responses).")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
